title: Ngā Kaiwhakaatu i Mate
intro: I ngā wā o mua, i noho tētahi hapori i tētahi whenua e whakawhiti ana i ngā emepaea. I karangahia rātou e tā rātou poropiti ki te ara o te pono, heoi i piri tonu rātou ki te kore whakapono me te tukino. Ka mutu tēnei kōrero i te whiu a te Atua. Ka taea e koe te tautuhi i tēnei iwi me tō rātou mutunga mai i ngā tohu i raro nei?
clues: I whakakahoretia e te iwi te whakatūpato i kawea mai e tētahi o ā rātou ake karere.
I karanga mai te karere kia karakia ki a Allah anake, ā, i whakatūpato hoki kia kaua e pirau.
Ko tā tātou hara he whakakahore i te poropiti i tonoa mai ki a tātou me te tika.
I ruarua mātou i te mana o te karere, ā, i whakapae mātou i a ia mō te tinihanga.
I pā mai te whiu ki a mātou i a mātou e noho humarie ana i roto i ō mātou kāinga.
I whakangaromia tātou mō te whakakahore i tō tātou poropiti, me te whakatoi i te hunga whakapono.

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Te whiwhi i tētahi poropiti i karanga ki te tika
Te haereere i roto i te moana
trial.answer: Te whiwhi i tētahi poropiti i karanga ki te tika

outcome.label: Hua
options: I whakangaromia te iwi mō te kore whakapono
I ripeneta te iwi, ā, i arahina rātou
I tomo te iwi ki Pararaiha
I ora te iwi, ā, i tupu nui
I heke te iwi ki tētahi whenua hou
outcome.answer: I whakangaromia te iwi mō te kore whakapono

arabic: وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًۭا فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱرْجُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verse: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption." (29:36)
